request.prompt: One realistic large irregular weathered limestone boulder, about 1 metre high and 1.7 metres wide, an asymmetrical rounded mass with layered erosion, shallow fissures, softened fractured edges and subtle surface pits. Broad natural resting underside, readable sculptural silhouette, substantial solid stone. Neutral landscaping object. No moss, no crystals, no pedestal, no surrounding pebbles, no ground plane. Entire object visible with generous margin, isolated on pure white, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio lighting, detailed physical geometry, no text, no cast shadow.
